profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Java, Spring Boot, Distributed Systems, Cloud & Data Pipelines | Backend / Platform Engineering
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with 5+ years of experience building backend systems, event-driven microservices, data workflows, and cloud-native applications.

My strongest lane is backend/platform engineering: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, JMS, Apache Artemis, ActiveMQ, SQL, AWS, Docker, OpenShift, Jenkins, CI/CD, production debugging, code review, and engineering standards.

At NTT DATA, I design and support Java/Spring Boot microservices and integration workflows across enterprise systems. I have also worked on KPI/reporting platforms, SQL performance tuning, API integrations, React migrations, and AI-backed research systems using Python, Flask, Firebase, and Java.

I am targeting senior backend, Java/Spring Boot, cloud backend, platform engineering, and data pipeline roles where reliability, maintainability, distributed systems, and practical automation matter.

Core areas:
- Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA
- Event-driven architecture, JMS, Apache Artemis, ActiveMQ
- Microservices, APIs, distributed systems
- AWS, Docker, OpenShift, Jenkins, CI/CD
- SQL tuning, schema design, reporting/data workflows
- Production debugging, observability, code review, mentoring
Portfolio: https://kunjp19.github.io
GitHub: https://github.com/kunjp19

Delivered highly available solutions using AWS services, Kafka, and Kubernetes, supporting high-priority business initiatives and system optimization.
